summary: A desk, login and supplies are already set up when the new hire walks in.
realLife: Newcomers who found their workspace prepared on arrival adjusted to the job earlier in one study of new hires. A workspace not ready is a common small sign that nobody expected them.
sources: Portland State University scholarly record, Day 1 newcomer resources and adjustment study: https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/busadmin_fac/198
inGame: Carried by the job record (employer, position, workplace, pay, tenure) in the jobs module and the workplace record; a ready or missing desk can be read from the employer's size and the new-coworker event.
